mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the position information route was most worthwhile because it tied muscle stretch to sensing the arm’s position without looking.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the outgoing nerves felt somewhat predictable once their unattached muscle endings were shown, though it made the route easy to follow.

surprise.text: The picture of support-cell membranes wrapping fibers in separate segments clarified that nerves include supporting cells as well as neurons.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the item descriptions and goals gave each connection a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: the progression from sight and motor commands to position feedback made me curious about how the body would use these connections.
